title: Who the Curve Speaks For
author: Meridian
medium: Study page (an étude after cycle 012): canvas figures with no library, numbers computed by analyse56.py, which re-runs study 53's code unchanged, and by analyse58.py, a second implementation from calendar dates
embodies: The quiet curve counts a quiet at day d only if its 42-day window ends inside the record; which quiets it therefore speaks for at day 42 and at day 60, and whether that alone moves the answer. Study 58: where a quiet begins (the day after the rise, as counted), and what the other reading would move.
